name: sendNewMessageNotificationWebhook
shortDescription: Dispatches a webhook notification to external systems when a new secure message is exchanged.
description:
Overview

Sends a webhook notification to external systems when a new secure message is sent between a patient and doctor. This facilitates real-time integration with other communication or monitoring platforms.

Intended use

This function is intended to be invoked as an event handler, typically triggered by a platform post-save hook on the Message entity. It receives the new message details as parameters.

Logic

  1. Receive the Message record details from the triggering event.
  2. Construct a JSON payload containing relevant message information (ID, sender ID, receiver ID, conversation ID, timestamp).
  3. Send the payload to the configured WebhookService using ctx.service('WebhookService').send_notification.
  4. Audit-log the webhook dispatch with ctx.audit.log, including the message ID and webhook status.

Entities

  • Message

External Services

  • WebhookService
